preconditions.expression: isinstance(T, str) and all(c.islower() for c in T) and 1 <= len(T) <= 100000
preconditions.description: T is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 100,000.
N is an integer between 1 and 600, inclusive.
stdin contains exactly two lines: the first line is T, the second line is N.

postconditions.description: stdout is a non-negative integer representing the number of distinct decorations.

postconditions.expression: all(len(bouquet) > 0 for bouquet in all_bouquets) and all(bouquet in substrings for bouquet in all_bouquets) and all(is_palindrome(bouquet) for bouquet in all_bouquets)
postconditions.description: Every bouquet in the decoration is a non-empty substring of T and is a palindrome (symmetric).
The output is the count of distinct decorations where no two decorations are similar (cyclic shift or reversed cyclic shift).

postconditions.expression: (lambda: (substrings := [T[i:j] for i in range(len(T)) for j in range(i+1, len(T)+1)]), (palindromes := [s for s in substrings if is_palindrome(s)]), (all_bouquets := [tuple(bouquet) for bouquet in product(palindromes, repeat=N)]), (distinct_decorations := set()), (seen := set()), (seen_reversed := set()), (seen_cyclic := set()), (seen_reversed_cyclic := set()), (for bouquet in all_bouquets: (key := tuple(bouquet), (reversed_key := tuple(reversed(bouquet)), (cyclic_keys := [tuple(bouquet[i:] + bouquet[:i]) for i in range(len(bouquet))]), (reversed_cyclic_keys := [tuple(reversed(bouquet[i:] + bouquet[:i])) for i in range(len(bouquet))]), (if key not in seen and reversed_key not in seen_reversed and all(k not in seen_cyclic for k in cyclic_keys) and all(k not in seen_reversed_cyclic for k in reversed_cyclic_keys): (distinct_decorations.add(key), (seen.add(key), (seen_reversed.add(reversed_key), (seen_cyclic.update(cyclic_keys), seen_reversed_cyclic.update(reversed_cyclic_keys))))))))
postconditions.description: The output is computed by generating all possible N-length sequences of palindromic substrings of T, then filtering out those that are similar (cyclic shift or reversed cyclic shift) to any previously counted decoration.
